newsitem.title: USA: UNC's Lear gets Air Force contract.
newsitem.headline: UNC's Lear gets Air Force contract.

text.p: UNC Lear Services said Monday it had been awarded the contract field team services contract by the U.S. Air Force Oklahoma City Air Logistics Center, Tinker AFB, Okla.

The company, a unit of UNC Inc, said the 10-year time-and-material type contract --- consisting of a two-year base period and four two-year option periods --- represents a potential value of over $1.0 billion.

Under the contract, UNC Lear Services, a subsidiary of UNC Aviation Services, will repair, maintain, modify, overhaul and support equipment for the Department of Defense and other federal agency customers.
